PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $c | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize; foreach \($x in $c\) { Get-Process -Id $x.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,StartTime } } else { "Nothing listening on port 3000" })

PowerShell(Stop-Process -Id 165220 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { "STILL HELD by PID " + $c[0].OwningProcess } else { "port 3000 free" })

Bash(node -e "const y=require\('js-yaml'\); const s=require\('fs'\).readFileSync\('.github/workflows/refresh.yml','utf8'\); const d=y.load\(s\); const steps=d.jobs.refresh.steps.map\(x=>x.run||x.uses||x.name\); console.log\('steps:', steps\); console.log\('install step:', steps.find\(x=>x&&x.includes\('npm install'\)\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const p=require\('./data/players.json'\); const k=Object.keys\(p\); console.log\('count',k.length\); console.log\(JSON.stringify\(p[k[0]]\)\); console.log\(JSON.stringify\(p[k[1]]\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const p=require\('./data/players.json'\); const k=Object.keys\(p\); let withAge=0; for\(const id of k\){if\(p[id].age!=null\)withAge++;} console.log\('withAge',withAge,'of',k.length\);")

Bash(node -e "const m=require\('./data/marts/rosterAge.json'\); console.log\('season',m.season,'positions',m.positions,'leagueAvgAge',m.leagueAvgAge\); console.log\('leagueAvgByPos',JSON.stringify\(m.leagueAvgByPos\)\); console.log\('teams',m.teams.length\); const t=m.teams[0]; console.log\('youngest team avgAge',t.avgAge,'players',t.players,'aged',t.agedPlayers\); console.log\('byPos', t.byPos.map\(p=>p.pos+':'+p.avgAge+'\('+p.count+'\)'\).join\(' '\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const m=require\('./data/marts/integrity.json'\); const w=m.weeks; console.log\('flagged weeks',w.length\); const flips=w.filter\(x=>x.flipsResult\); console.log\('flippable losses',flips.length\); const f=flips[0]; if\(f\) console.log\('example:',f.season,'wk',f.week,'played',f.actualPoints,'bestActual',f.bestActualPoints,'opp',f.opponentPoints,'result',f.result,'flips',f.flipsResult\);")
